card.name: Space before a size in inches
card.fires_on: The space just before a number that gives a size in inches or feet, as in 'about 10 inches' or 'up to 17 inches long'. Also seen on a space before a closing quotation mark after quoted speech.

modes.label: Space before a measurement
modes.description: A space after 'about', 'to', 'almost' or 'of' where a length in inches comes next, in plant or animal size descriptions.

modes.label: Space before a closing quote
modes.description: A space before a closing quotation mark that ends a quoted statement.

card.writes: It favors punctuation and bracket-like closers and suppresses quotation marks, so it does not push a quote mark to come next.
card.plain: It marks the gap right before a number giving a size in inches, such as the length of an animal or plant.
